cu_estimate.resume_pipeline_note: 2026-04-27: Estimate confirmed valid. The concern that NT-001 implemented Traverse.AI.Abstractions/Providers (scope of NT-002) was a false alarm — those are pre-existing projects adopted into the solution, not new NT-001 deliverables. NT-002 scope covers 6 entirely new library projects (Domain.Primitives, Infrastructure.Persistence, Messaging, Auth, Http, Observability) none of which exist yet. Estimate 6 new components × base CU formula = 57.75 CU remains accurate. Minor additional scope: NT-002 should also retarget existing AI projects from net9.0 to net10.0 per ADR-004; this is within the ±50–100% confidence bounds and does not warrant re-estimation.

false_alarm_investigated.concern: NT-001 implemented Traverse.AI.Abstractions and Traverse.AI.Providers — scope of NT-002
false_alarm_investigated.finding: FALSE ALARM. These are pre-existing projects. NT-001 code review confirmed 'AI projects untouched — git diff src/shared/ returns empty'. NT-002 CU estimate (57.75) remains valid — all 6 new shared library projects are still unimplemented.
false_alarm_investigated.resolution: No scope change to NT-002. Minor note added: NT-002 should retarget AI projects from net9.0 to net10.0 per ADR-004.

decision_log.decision: Use net10.0 as target framework for all new projects created in NT-002 through NT-005. Retarget existing AI projects (currently net9.0) to net10.0 in NT-002.
decision_log.rationale: Single TFM across the solution prevents multi-targeting complexity. .NET 10 SDK is the available runtime. No functional difference for Phase 0 scaffolding work.
decision_log.title: .NET 10.0 selected as target framework for all projects
decision_log.context: Developer machine has only .NET 10 SDK (10.0.103). Traverse.AI.Providers already requires Microsoft.Extensions.*.Version=10.0.* packages to resolve OpenAI SDK 2.x transitive dependency. Building with net9.0 TFM on .NET 10 SDK caused NU1605 (Warning As Error).
